fs/link#

SymbolicLink is a path command object.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let current = SymbolicLink(path: releases.path().child("current"));
current.create(target: Path("v3.2.0"));

Description#

SymbolicLink is a path command object. Construction never touches the filesystem; create() and remove() are explicit commands and return nothing:

target() returns exactly the target stored in the link. A relative target is not silently joined to the link's parent. existence() uses lstat, so a broken symbolic link still exists. remove() first verifies the entry kind and can never delete a regular file or directory accidentally.

Hard links use the same command shape:

let destination = backup.path().child("state.db");
HardLink(source: source, destination: destination).create();
let snapshot = FileEntry(path: destination);

Both commands fail when their destination already exists. Symbolic-link targets need not exist. HardLink accepts only an existing regular file and rejects directories and symbolic-link source entries portably.
